text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working machine learning freelancer with 6 years of experience building practical AI solutions in Python and related ML stacks. I’m interested in your brain tumor diagnosis project and can help with the full workflow from dataset preparation through model training, validation, testing, and reporting.

For the proposed CNN pipeline, I can support the organization of train/validation/test splits, preparation of images and labeled masks in a model-ready format, and clear documentation of the dataset details. I also understand the importance of presenting the methodology in a way that is easy to follow, including the model architecture, layer-by-layer input/output dimensions, and a complete hyperparameter table.

In a recent telecom churn prediction project, I built a monthly churn score for 380k subscribers with per-customer SHAP reasons the retention team could read, using Python, XGBoost, pandas, SHAP, and MLflow. That work achieved an AUC of 0.84 on a held-out quarter and a top-decile lift of 3.1x. While that project was different from medical imaging, it reinforced the importance of disciplined data preparation, reproducible training, and clear performance reporting.

For your MRI segmentation and classification task, I can help document and evaluate the model with the metrics you listed: Accuracy, IoU, Dice Coefficient, Recall, Precision, and F1 score. I can also structure the visual outputs you need, including original image, ground truth, and prediction examples, plus performance tables, confusion analysis, and a clear comparison of results with and without data augmentation.

My background includes Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. I’m comfortable working carefully through technical documentation requirements and turning model results into polished, publication-style sections for methodology, results, discussion, and comparison.

If you’d like, I can help produce a clean, well-documented solution that not only trains the model but also presents the work in a structured and professional way.
